SRC-036:R004.text: Audit 13 items 5-6: all INAUDIT continuation controls emit bare saipen cc; do not use gg with audit paths as ingestion.

SRC-036:R005.text: Audit 13 item 7: manual Delete remains explicit operator action; normal successful deletion belongs to SAIPEN consume.
